footer_blurb: Alpha Appliance Repair. Home and commercial appliance service across Orlando.
about_p1: Alpha Appliance Repair is an Orlando outfit running a small fleet of vans across the city and the towns around it, working on refrigerators, washers, dryers, ovens, cooktops and dishwashers.
about_p2: You get a message when the technician is on the way, the fault gets explained before anyone starts pulling the machine apart, and the work is done there in your kitchen rather than hauled off to a shop.

services.title: Refrigerator and freezer repair
services.body: Not cooling, icing up, or running constantly. Sealed system, compressor, defrost and control board work on domestic and motorhome fridges.

services.title: Washer and dryer repair
services.body: Drain pumps, bearings, blowers and control boards on front and top loaders, put right in the laundry room rather than taken away.
services.alt: Technician in a navy Alpha Appliance Repair shirt kneeling at an open refrigerator in a customer's kitchen, tool bag on the floor beside a white gas range.

services.title: Oven, range and cooktop repair
services.body: Elements that will not heat, boards that will not respond, and gas and electric ranges brought back into service.

services.title: Dishwasher repair
services.body: Leaks, drainage faults and dead control boards on built in dishwashers, domestic and commercial.

services.title: Commercial kitchen equipment
services.body: Convection ovens and commercial dishwashers serviced around your opening hours so the kitchen keeps running.

reviews.author: Marianne H. Marrou
reviews.text: Vlad, the repairman for Alpha Appliance, arrived on time (I was notified when he was on his way). He worked very hard and long cleaning my washing machine (it really needed it!). He was extremely polite and did a great job!

reviews.author: Sia Tomoson
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Alpha Appliance Repair. The technician was very professional, arrived on time, and clearly explained the issue before starting the repair. Everything was done quickly and efficiently, and the appliance is working perfectly now.

reviews.author: Linda Loy
reviews.text: I highly recommend Alpha Repair. Not only did our repair man respond quickly but he was able to quickly diagnose the problem and resolve the problem. The price was very reasonable. 5 stars. So glad we found a reliable repair service.
